info.name: Organization & Membership API
info.description: End-to-end tests for /api/organizations. Before running: sign up the supervisor account and run `node scripts/promoteSupervisor.js <supEmail>`. Supply supPassword and custPassword at run time (they are intentionally blank here).

item.name: Creator is SUPERVISOR member of both orgs

exec: pm.test("Creator is SUPERVISOR member of both orgs: status 200", () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([200]));
const find = id => m.find(x => x.organizationId._id === pm.collectionVariables.get(id));
pm.test("Ticket rejected before membership exists: status 403", () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([403]));
pm.test("Role must match account role: status 400", () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([400]));

item.name: Supervisor of another org cannot assign members

exec: pm.test("Supervisor of another org cannot assign members: status 403", () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([403]));

item.name: Add Customer A to Org A

exec: pm.test("Add Customer A to Org A: status 201", () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([201]));

item.name: Add Customer B to Org B

exec: pm.test("Add Customer B to Org B: status 201", () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([201]));
pm.test("org A has supervisor and customer A", () => pm.expect(m.map(x => x.userId._id)).to.have.members([pm.collectionVariables.get("supId"), pm.collectionVariables.get("custAId")]));
pm.test("no password in member data", () => m.forEach(x => pm.expect(x.userId).to.not.have.property("password")));

item.name: Supervisor cannot list members of another org

exec: pm.test("Supervisor cannot list members of another org: status 403", () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([403]));
pm.test("Customer sees only own memberships: status 200", () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([200]));
pm.test("all memberships belong to customer A", () => pm.response.json().data.forEach(x => pm.expect(x.userId).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("custAId"))));
pm.test("Customer can view own organization: status 200", () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([200]));
pm.test("Customer cannot view another organization: status 403", () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([403]));

item.name: Ticket created with valid CUSTOMER membership

exec: pm.test("Ticket created with valid CUSTOMER membership: status 201", () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([201]));

item.name: Ticket rejected for another org's ID

exec: pm.test("Ticket rejected for another org's ID: status 403", () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([403]));

item.name: Cannot delete another org's membership via this org

exec: pm.test("Cannot delete another org's membership via this org: status 404", () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([404]));
pm.test("Supervisor cannot remove own membership: status 400", () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([400]));

item.name: Remove Customer A from Org A

exec: pm.test("Remove Customer A from Org A: status 200", () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([200]));
pm.test("Ticket rejected after membership removal: status 403", () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([403]));

item.name: Removed customer can no longer view org

exec: pm.test("Removed customer can no longer view org: status 403", () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([403]));
